headline: CONMAT small-caps GEL and DCON lead the tape with extreme volume; EMC logs +100% intraday on a -50% open gap, warranting clarification checks.
market_take: Coverage breadth is dominated by micro-cap moves rather than broad sector themes: the top percentage gainers (GEL +66.67%, DCON +26.67%, JCK +13.33%) sit on very low prices and elevated-to-extreme volume ratios, while downside is led by PF and PLE, both backed by fundamental filings. The most extreme alert of the day is EMC with a -50% open gap followed by a +100% intraday recovery, which is a classic manipulation/spike pattern that should be tied back to any SET clarification filings. PROP is the most active sector by alert count, reflecting both true trading signals (JCK, PLAT, AWC) and housekeeping-driven items (PF earnings delay, A director resignation). 5-day leaders KC and JCK alongside 5-day laggard A suggest momentum is concentrated in very small names and is not a market-wide trend.

sector_notes.note: Mixed: AQUA -9.09% and XBIO -16.67% open gap conflict with XBIO +20.00% intraday and a SET clarification filing (29 Sep), suggesting the name is in active dialogue with the Exchange; OKJ volume spike 4.5σ is the standout signal.

Heaviest sector by alert count and filings: JCK +13.33% pairs with an acquisition/disposal of a subsidiary filing and 4.04x volume; PF -20.00% on the day sits alongside a high-impact late Q2/2026 financial statements submission and a Chief Accountant appointment, i.e. a governance-plus-fundamentals flag.

GEL +66.67% vol×5.09 and DCON +26.67% vol×11.74 are the day's strongest moves by both price and volume; SCC filed a medium-impact JV progress update, providing a fundamental anchor for the sector even though it is not in the mover list.

ITD volume spike 9.2σ is the single largest volume anomaly in the digest; PLE -16.67% intraday aligns with its 5-day loss of -28.6%, and SEAFCO filed a new-projects update worth cross-checking against the move.

Activity is filing-driven rather than price-driven: CTARAF announced a 37th registered capital decrease (high impact), AXTRART disclosed appraisal values, CPTREIT and CTARAF held unitholder meetings, and SSTRT and MII showed volume or portfolio activity.
Quiet session: VPO -6.52% is the only mover, while SMO's 6.1σ volume spike stands out against otherwise subdued trading in the sector.
